## What we study

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .research-card}
### Affective Representation
How emotions and affective experiences are organized across sensory modalities, individuals, and cognitive systems.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .research-card}
### Multivariate Methods
Developing and applying multivariate approaches for understanding psychological structure and representation.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .research-card}
### Brain & Physiology
Studying affect and cognition with neuroimaging and psychophysiological measures.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .research-card}
### Humans & Artificial Intelligence
Using AI as a model, comparison system, and experimental participant in psychological science.
:::
:::
